people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.
translations.bsb: And at that time, each of the Israelites returned from there to his own tribe and clan, each to his own inheritance.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
